reserveReview.rationale: R02 refresh 2026-09-29 (prior review 2026-08-08 had crossed the composition freshness window): all source pages were re-read and the material findings are unchanged, so this is a re-verified re-dating rather than a date bump. Avalon documentation still describes exactly two mint paths — an FBTC-backed CeDeFi CDP loan and USDT deposited at 1:1 (with a 1:1 USDa-to-USDT conversion vault on Ethereum) — and still publishes no supply-weighted split between FBTC-collateralized debt and 1:1 fiat-token deposits. The risk-management page still lists FBTC (60% max LTV / 90% liquidation threshold / 80% recovery, subject to liquidation) plus USDC and USDT at 100% max LTV and exempt from liquidation, names Cobo, Fireblocks, and Coinbase Prime for protocol-asset custody, asserts custody addresses are publicly available without listing them, and names Redstone as the BTC-USD oracle. DefiLlama's avalon-usda adapter methodology is materially unchanged (FBTC collateral plus optional USDT/USDe/sUSDe at documented pool and USDaMinter Safe owners, excluding Avalon-minted wrappers lfbtc/WFBTC and V3 treasuries) and reported $2.00 total TVL ($2.99956 on Ethereum, all other chains zero) at the 2026-09-29 read, versus $145,575,231.78 circulating USDa. On-chain adapter balances therefore still do not reconcile circulating liability, and no dual-source percentage split is available, so the single reserve remains dispositioned as an untracked exogenous CeDeFi envelope rather than a splittable basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Officially documented issuance and collateral paths re-verified 2026-09-29; constituent shares remain undisclosed; independent DefiLlama CDP TVL and circulating-supply reads confirm continued non-reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The single disclosed reserve category remains an untracked exogenous CeDeFi envelope. Avalon does not publish the current proportions of FBTC-backed debt, USDT deposits, and USDC deposits, and on-chain adapter balances do not measure full backing.
